name: ZN 10-Year Auction Intraday Reaction
description: Detects 10-year Treasury auction results on ZN at 1:00 PM ET using datetime_extract (hour==13, minute==0). Flags bars where absolute 1-min return exceeds 0.01% as auction events. Measures forward price reaction at 5, 15, and 30 minutes post-auction using forward_returns. Displays avg absolute move at each interval in a summary table and bar chart, with clickable event markers showing per-auction returns. Uses LiquidityBased rollover with BackwardRatio adjustment for clean returns across rolls.
source:
# =============================================================================
# ZN 10-YEAR TREASURY AUCTION INTRADAY REACTION
# =============================================================================
# 10-year auctions typically release results at 1:00 PM ET.
# Detection: hour==13 & minute==0 in New York time, plus |1-min return| > 0.01%
# Measurement: forward_returns at 5, 15, and 30 minutes post-auction
# =============================================================================

# === DATA SOURCE (1Min bars) ===
src = market_data_source()()

# === CONTINUOUS CONTRACT (LiquidityBased + BackwardRatio for clean returns) ===
cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
close = cont.c

# === AUCTION BAR DETECTION ===
bar_hour = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.hour, timezone='America/New_York')(index())
bar_minute = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.minute, timezone='America/New_York')(index())
is_1pm = (bar_hour == 13) and (bar_minute == 0)

# 1-min return: (close - prior close) / prior close
prev_close = close >> 1
ret_1m = (close - prev_close) / prev_close

# Flag auction event: 1:00 PM ET bar with |1-min return| > 0.01% (1 tick threshold)
is_auction = is_1pm and (abs(ret_1m) > 0.0001)

# === FORWARD RETURNS AT EACH TIME MARK ===
fwd_5m = forward_returns(period=5)(close)
fwd_15m = forward_returns(period=15)(close)
fwd_30m = forward_returns(period=30)(close)

# === ABSOLUTE MOVES FILTERED TO AUCTION EVENTS ===
auction_abs_5m = where(is_auction, abs(fwd_5m))
auction_abs_15m = where(is_auction, abs(fwd_15m))
auction_abs_30m = where(is_auction, abs(fwd_30m))

# === EVENT MARKER FIELDS (signed returns for directional detail) ===
auction_ret_1m = where(is_auction, ret_1m)
auction_fwd_5m = where(is_auction, fwd_5m)
auction_fwd_15m = where(is_auction, fwd_15m)
auction_fwd_30m = where(is_auction, fwd_30m)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- Summary Table: Avg |Move| at each mark + auction count ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='ZN Avg Absolute Move After 10-Year Auction',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Auction Events'],
        col_headers=['Avg |Move| 5min', 'Avg |Move| 15min', 'Avg |Move| 30min', 'Auction Count'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='Auction Reaction'
)(auction_abs_5m, auction_abs_15m, auction_abs_30m, auction_abs_5m)

# --- Bar Chart: Avg |Move| at 5, 15, 30 min ---
xy_bars(
    title='ZN Avg Absolute Move by Interval After Auction',
    category='Auction Reaction',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    y_axis_label='Avg |Move|',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='5-Min Mark', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='15-Min Mark', color=Color.Indigo),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='30-Min Mark', color=Color.Slate)
    ])
)(auction_abs_5m, auction_abs_15m, auction_abs_30m)

# --- Event Markers: click to navigate to each auction ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='10-Year Auction Result',
        icon=Icon.BellRingIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='1-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='5-Min Fwd Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='15-Min Fwd Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='30-Min Fwd Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    )
)(is_auction, auction_ret_1m, auction_fwd_5m, auction_fwd_15m, auction_fwd_30m)
